vm._doc: Build/staging profile used to pre-stage the replacement before the cutover. BUILD profile for the prod firewall's replacement (blue/green). Same hardware as vm-opns-01 so nothing changes at cutover, but only the OOB NIC is on a real bridge — every other NIC sits on the unused cctv VNet, and there is no WAN section, so this box cannot collide with the running firewall or dial an ISP. It carries a TEMPORARY OOB address; the real profile (vm-opns-01.json, .196) is seeded during the window, which replaces config.xml while the firmware and plugins installed here stay on disk.
vm.name: vm-opns-01-next
